title: Euler totient multiplicativity and prime-power formulas

problemStatement.plain: Use the Euler-totient Lean support around coprime multiplicativity, prime-power evaluation, and the unit-group/cardinality interpretation. These zero-sorry files provide the arithmetic group-theory infrastructure needed before tackling Carmichael-function formulas at powers of 2.
whyMatters: Totient multiplicativity is the CRT-backed counting principle behind many modular-arithmetic formulas.
Prime-power evaluation is the local factor in Euler product computations for phi.
The unit-group interpretation connects the arithmetic function to multiplicative groups modulo n.

proven: `totient_mul_coprime` proves multiplicativity of `Nat.totient` for coprime factors.
`totient_prime_pow` proves the prime-power formula for Euler's totient.
`totient_eq_card_units` identifies `Nat.totient n` with the cardinality of units in `ZMod n`.
`totient_mul_crt_explanation` records the CRT explanation for multiplicativity.
open: The Carmichael formula for powers of two is motivational context here; the cited Lean anchors are totient/CRT infrastructure rather than a completed Carmichael-function proof.
knownResults.goal: Expose the completed totient infrastructure as the safe formal base for later Carmichael-function work.

currentState.focus: Initial problem understanding. Read problem.md and gather context.
currentState.nextAction: Read problem.md thoroughly and acquire full context.
